name: University of Virginia

sources.label: Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy

notes: Batten mostly repeats the main Trumba (9 of 12); Trumba uva-seas/uva-law/uva-library/uva-arts/uva-nursing are mislabelled slices of the main calendar; engineering.virginia.edu and law.virginia.edu answer 403 (Cloudflare); School of Data Science is a Nuxt app with no feed.

name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
notes: No feed added: cs.unc.edu, sph.unc.edu (Gillings), law.unc.edu, med.unc.edu, stat-or and datascience.unc.edu all return 403 to a bot user-agent (200 to a browser), so their tribe/ical endpoints are closed to us; Kenan-Flagler events are WordPress HTML with no events API.

name: University of Southern California
notes: Viterbi's RSS (viterbi.usc.edu/events/admin/feed.php) puts the date only as MM/DD/YYYY in the title, which our rss reader cannot parse; Annenberg (Drupal) and Marshall have no feed; Price School's CNDPS ?ical=1 has 1 event.

name: University of California, San Diego
notes: Main Localist already carries Rady, HDSI and Jacobs; HDSI's own tribe API is empty, CSE's Google calendar (a room resource) has no upcoming events, Jacobs/CSE/Rady/UCSD Health pages have no feed.

name: New York University

sources.label: NYU School of Global Public Health
NYU Wagner Graduate School of Public Service
NYU Silver School of Social Work
NYU Tisch School of the Arts
NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing
NYU Wasserman Center for Career Development

notes: Important: the main NYU feed (/live/json/events) reads only page 1 = 100 events (about 2 days) because the livewhale reader does not page; group feeds use the group's fullname (/group/Engineering, not the title) and add /response_fields/description for food words. Student-Life group repeats the main feed's first page, and with /response_fields/description it threw 'Invalid code point' in strip() (an &#NNNN; entity beyond Unicode). Stern, Law and Medicine groups are nearly empty; Courant seminars, Stern and Law sites are HTML only; Wagner and CDS sites 403.

name: University of Florida
notes: Engineering and CISE WordPress REST is login-only (401) but /events/?ical=1 works for eng.ufl.edu (CISE returns 0); ai.ufl.edu uses the main LiveWhale; UF Health and Law have no feed.

name: University of Texas at Austin
notes: CS calendar ical (apps.cs.utexas.edu/calendar/events/ical, 34 upcoming) is disallowed by robots.txt (Disallow: /calendar/), needs an owner decision; McCombs REST is 401, Cockrell posts to the main Localist, LBJ (Drupal utevent) and Oden have no feed.

name: Georgia Institute of Technology

sources.label: Scheller College of Business
sources.note: The JSON behind scheller.gatech.edu/events/calendar.html: {events:[{title,startDate,endDate ('2026-11-18T12:00-0500'),description,url,filter1..}]}, no location field; about 70 events, past and upcoming.

notes: The existing GT taxonomy term feeds (13, 20) now read 0 upcoming: their dates come from the posting time; the event time is in a second <time> tag after 'Event time', so they need a reader fix. College of Computing, IDEaS and calendar.gatech.edu have no all-events feed (no JSON:API, no ical).

name: University of California, Davis
notes: www.ucdavis.edu/events is Drupal HTML with no feed; engineering, cs, letters-and-science and Mondavi sites 403 to the bot; UC Davis Health has no events feed.

name: University of California, Irvine

sources.label: Donald Bren School of Information & Computer Sciences

notes: Social Sciences Google calendar (ucisocsci@gmail.com public ics, 10 upcoming) is disallowed by Google's robots.txt, needs an owner decision; Merage's event-json.js has start/end as epoch milliseconds, which the json reader cannot use; Law uses CampusGroups (already covered by ZotSpot); Humanities Drupal has no feed.

name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
notes: Not added because calendars.illinois.edu robots.txt disallows /ical (the existing UIUC feeds carry an owner decision): Webtools icalGmail ids 2568 Grainger All Events (119 upcoming, 5 food, 71 not in main), 7097 NCSA (18), 1233 MCB (25), 1968 Physics (24), 1381 Chemistry (9), 4862 Economics (4); also Webtools ics times are floating (no TZID param) so our parser reads them as UTC, 6 h off, existing UIUC feeds included.

name: Boston College
notes: No feed added: Carroll School, Law and centres publish into events.bc.edu (their pages call the same Localist API), which is already the main feed.

name: Tufts University

sources.label: Friedman School of Nutrition Science and Policy

notes: soe-cs and tisch-college Trumba calendars repeat the main Tufts Trumba; arts-sciences has only holidays; careers.tufts.edu has no events API.
